tool_args.rationale: All five paid observations have H≤0.48 and show positive gain. The slow-horizon probe tests the predicted sign reversal near the forecast horizon and constrains its magnitude before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-horizon rows mostly constrain the ratio of slow amplitude to slow time constant, not the two parameters separately. That leaves the forecast at H=21.1 uncertain.
Finer short-horizon measurements would refine the fast response but would not directly measure the late reversal.
